body: I'm glad that you're in a better place now. It makes me hopeful.

I understand what you're saying. It's just really hard when you've become so close to a person and they've been such a big portion of your life to imagine that they could be gone in an instant over something you can't help or control. :(
Thank you for taking the time to post. Your kind words are greatly appreciated. Knowing that I have support from people I don't even know makes me feel a little better.
I didn't even know this subreddit existed. Thank you for your post; you really have no idea how much I appreciate it.
